faq.q: What is the origin of Islam?
faq.a: Islam is associated with Arabic. Islam is Arabic إِسْلَام (Islām) 'submission, surrender, peace', from the root س ل م (s-l-m). The source gloss 'Submission to Allah' is broadly consistent.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Islam, islam. Script forms are إسلام, اسلام, इस्लाम.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
